webCold.original: The laboratory did not confirm that the new battery was safe. At 20 °C, its mass fell by 3.5%, while the pressure remained below 101.3 kPa. Dr. Chen asked the team to record every result, including observations that contradicted their prediction.
webCold.translation: 实验室并未确认新电池是安全的。在20°C下，其质量下降了3.5%，而压力保持在101.3 kPa以下。陈博士要求团队记录每一项结果，包括与他们的预测相矛盾的观察。
